id: 06_Risk group classes biosafety level rating of GMOs part5 biosafety level risk gro
title: 转基因生物的风险组别与生物安全等级
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/06_Risk group classes biosafety level rating of GMOs part5 biosafety level risk gro.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/06_Risk group classes biosafety level rating of GMOs part5 biosafety level risk gro/src.py

points.K1: 基因改造：把基因搬个家
points.K3: 转基因生物：遗传物质被改过

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四级台阶前向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a four-step staircase and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲转基因生物怎么分级。
overlay: 转基因生物的风险组别与生物安全等级

shots.scene: 四个大小不同的盾牌排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four shields in a row, growing larger from left to right. No people.
shots.narration: 风险分几类，防护就配几级。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白课题表，站在两扇实验室门前犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank project form and hesitates between two lab doors.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做转基因课题，该进哪间实验室？

shots.scene: 小研指着白板上的四级台阶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points to a four-step staircase drawn on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看它属于哪一类风险。

shots.section_title: 基因改造：把基因搬个家
shots.scene: 一段彩色基因从一个细胞移到另一个细胞
shots.prompt_en: A small colored gene segment moves from one cell icon into another cell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先复习：基因改造，
overlay: 基因改造：把基因搬个家

shots.section_title: 基因改造：把基因搬个家
shots.scene: 箭头连接供体和受体两个生物图标
shots.prompt_en: An arrow carries a gene from a donor organism icon to a recipient organism icon. No people.
shots.narration: 把一种生物的基因放进另一种生物。

shots.scene: 新品种植物和动物图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a new plant variety and a new fish variety with small sparkles. No people.
shots.narration: 生物的发育随之改变，出现新品种。

shots.section_title: 转基因生物：遗传物质被改过
shots.scene: DNA 双螺旋上换进一段不同颜色的片段
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix with one segment replaced by a differently colored piece. No people.
shots.narration: 用重组 DNA 技术改过遗传物质的，
overlay: 转基因生物：遗传物质被改过

shots.section_title: 转基因生物：遗传物质被改过
shots.scene: 一株植物和一个培养皿各贴一个蓝点标记
shots.prompt_en: A potted plant and a petri dish, each marked with a small blue dot. No people.
shots.narration: 就是转基因生物。

shots.scene: 基因图标分别指向叶片和蛋白质图标
shots.prompt_en: A gene icon with arrows pointing to a changed leaf and to a protein molecule icon. No people.
shots.narration: 改了基因，性状和蛋白都会变。

shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级一个空白牌子
shots.prompt_en: A four-step staircase, each step holding a blank sign. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因生物按危险度分成四类。

shots.scene: 一个人形图标和一群人形图标
shots.prompt_en: One person outline on the left and a crowd of person outlines on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 看对个人的风险，也看对人群的风险，

shots.scene: 人、动物、植物、环境四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a person, an animal, a plant and a landscape. No people.
shots.narration: 看对人、动物、植物和环境的影响，

shots.scene: 一个微生物图标向外扩散的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon with arrows spreading outward to the surroundings. No people.
shots.narration: 还看它会不会扩散出去。

shots.scene: 台阶第一级亮起，绿色
shots.prompt_en: The first step of the staircase lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 第1类：个体风险低，群体风险也低。

shots.scene: 转基因菌图标旁边人、动物、植物都打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon with a blue dot, next to a person, an animal and a plant, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不会伤害人和动物，不影响植物环境。

shots.scene: 培养皿里的普通实验室菌株图标
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish with a plain non-harmful lab strain colony icon. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的非致病实验室菌株就属于这类。

shots.scene: 台阶第二级亮起，黄色
shots.prompt_en: The second step of the staircase lights up yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 第2类：个体风险中等，群体风险低。

shots.scene: 人和动物图标上有黄色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A person and an animal icon each with a yellow exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 对人和动物健康有中等风险，

shots.scene: 扩散箭头很短，环境图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Short spreading arrows around a microbe icon and a landscape icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 但不容易扩散，对环境影响小。

shots.scene: 台阶第三级亮起，橙色
shots.prompt_en: The third step of the staircase lights up orange. No people.
shots.narration: 第3类：个体风险高，群体风险中等。

shots.scene: 人和动物图标上有橙色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person and an animal icon each with an orange warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可能严重危害人和动物健康，

shots.scene: 扩散箭头中等长度
shots.prompt_en: Medium-length spreading arrows around a microbe icon, with a half-filled warning bar. No people.
shots.narration: 扩散风险低到中等。

shots.scene: 台阶第四级亮起，红色
shots.prompt_en: The fourth step of the staircase lights up red. No people.
shots.narration: 第4类：个体风险高，群体风险也高。

shots.scene: 人、动物、植物、环境图标都带红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A person, an animal, a plant and a landscape icon, each with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害人畜健康，还会影响植物和环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地举起停止手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw in a serious stop gesture.
shots.narration: 这一类风险最高。

shots.scene: 四个盾牌从小到大，越来越厚
shots.prompt_en: Four shields from small to large, each thicker and more complex than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 对应的防护，也分为四级。

shots.scene: 实验室示意图逐级增加门、柜、防护服图标
shots.prompt_en: Four simple lab diagrams side by side, each adding more doors, cabinets and protective suit icons. No people.
shots.narration: 级别越高，限制越严，设施越复杂。

shots.scene: 台阶的第一级连到一级实验室门
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links step one of the staircase to a lab door with a single shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第1类的活动，在一级实验室做；

shots.scene: 第二级台阶连到二级实验室门
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links step two to a lab door with a biohazard warning sign and two shields. No people.
shots.narration: 第2类，对应二级；

shots.scene: 第三、四级台阶连到更高级别实验室门
shots.prompt_en: Arrows link steps three and four to heavier lab doors with three and four shields. No people.
shots.narration: 第3类对应三级，第4类对应四级。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个写着问号的箱子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a closed box with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲转基因生物的风险管理。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四级台阶和四个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a four-step staircase and four shields.
shots.narration: 危险度分四类，防护分四级。

shots.scene: 个体与群体、人畜与环境四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of one person, a crowd, an animal and a landscape. No people.
shots.narration: 看个体、群体，也看环境和扩散。

shots.scene: 四级台阶分别连到四扇实验室门
shots.prompt_en: Four steps of a staircase linked by arrows to four lab doors with one to four shields. No people.
shots.narration: 第几类风险，就配第几级防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰站在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at a lab door with a shield icon.
shots.narration: 分清类别，选对防护，下次见！
